#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    int tam;
    std::cin >> tam;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore newline after integer
    std::string cad;
    std::getline(std::cin, cad);

    std::vector<std::string> arr;
    std::string word;
    int cont = 0;
    int mayor = 0;
    bool flg = false;

    for (int i = 0; i < tam; ++i) {
        char c = cad[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '(':
                if (cont >= mayor) {
                    mayor = cont;
                }
                cont = 0;
                flg = true;
                break;

            case ')':
                flg = false;
                if (!word.empty()) {
                    arr.push_back(word);
                    word.clear();
                }
                break;

            default:
                if (flg) {
                    if (c != '_') {
                        word.push_back(c);
                    } else if (!word.empty()) {
                        arr.push_back(word);
                        word.clear();
                    }
                } else if (c != '_') {
                    cont++;
                    if (i == tam - 1 && cont >= mayor) {
                        mayor = cont;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (cont >= mayor) {
                        mayor = cont;
                    }
                    cont = 0;
                }
                break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << mayor << " " << arr.size() << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
